name: Infamy
desc:
The objective of the game is to cause total destruction.

Fight your way through progressively more difficult sets of enemies as you rampage your way towards total server domination.

	 ✅ Collect new weapons, armors, perks, and powerful allies as you progress through the game.
	 ✅ Spawn allies with the Cellphone tool. Upgrade their equipment at the dedicated AI Store building.
	 ✅ Defeat enemies and complete objectives to earn Cash and XP.
	 ✅ Your wanted level, perks, any items you buy - are all saved when you leave the game.
	 ✅ Roblox Plus members earn 50% more XP.

Work together with others to survive your way towards the end-stage where you will face a challenging set of 3 final bosses.

Private servers are completely free!

Note:
	All players are on the same criminal team. This is not a game where you can play as the police team.
	Generative AI was not used in the making of this game, except for, the voice lines of female characters.
